title.zh: ⚡️安全机构Salus：Revenue涉恶意授权，攻击者利用permit签名盗取资产
title.en: ⚡️安全机构Salus：Revenue涉恶意授权，攻击者利用permit签名盗取资产

current_state.zh: Security firm Salus reports that Revenue is tied to a malicious-approval scheme in which attackers submit users' permit signatures to grant unlimited USDG spending rights and immediately call transferFrom, draining wallets in a single transaction and splitting proceeds 20/80 between two hacker addresses.
current_state.en: Security firm Salus reports that Revenue is tied to a malicious-approval scheme in which attackers submit users' permit signatures to grant unlimited USDG spending rights and immediately call transferFrom, draining wallets in a single transaction and splitting proceeds 20/80 between two hacker addresses.
